info.name: Einride Extend: Authentication AuthenticationService BookingService API

params.name: parent
params.description:
The resource name of the parent, which owns this collection of tours.
Format: spaces/{space}

params.name: pageSize
params.description:
Requested page size. Server may return fewer tours than requested.
If unspecified, server will pick an appropriate default.

params.name: pageToken
params.description:
A token identifying a page of results the server should return.
Typically, this is the value of ListToursResponse.page_token returned from the previous call to `ListTours` method.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
How the results should be sorted. Presently, the only permitted values are:

- `"create_time desc"` (default if no order_by is specified)
- `"create_time asc"`
Example:
```
order_by = "create_time desc"
``

params.name: showDeleted
params.description: Controls whether deleted tours should be returned. Defaults to false.
